docs.contenu:
🎯 Objectives
- I can name the people in my family.
- I can present my family: This is my mother.

🔍 Warm-up
Finger family song! Daddy finger, daddy finger, where are you? Here I am, here I am, how do you do? Sing for mummy, brother, sister and baby!

📘 New words & structures
Family words: mother (mum), father (dad), brother, sister, grandmother, grandfather, baby, family.
Structures:
- This is my mother. Her name is Amel.
- This is my father. His name is Tarek.
- I have one brother and two sisters.
- I love my family!

✏️ Practice examples
1. This is my family: my father, my mother, my brother and me.
2. This is my grandmother. I love her very much.
3. My sister is small. She is a baby.
4. Who is this? This is my grandfather.

🛠️ How to say it
To present your family:
1. Point to the photo: This is my...
2. Say the name: Her name is... / His name is...
3. HER for girls and women, HIS for boys and men.

⭐ Remember
- Mother, sister and grandmother: HER name. Father, brother and grandfather: HIS name.
- I HAVE one brother. I HAVE two sisters.
- Family is love!

🔗 Try at home
Draw your family. Point to each person and say: This is my mum. This is my dad. Show your drawing to your family and say all the words in English!

🎲 Fun corner
Family photo game! Bring a family photo or a drawing. Point and let your friends guess: Is this your brother? Yes, it is! Mini-dialogue:
- Who is this?
- This is my grandmother. Her name is Zohra.
- And who is this?
- This is my little brother. He is a baby!

📋 Summary
Family words include mother, father, brother, sister, grandmother, grandfather and baby. We present family with This is my..., and we ask Who is this? For girls and women (mother, sister, grandmother) we say HER name; for boys and men (father, brother, grandfather) we say HIS name. We use I HAVE to count family members: I have one brother and two sisters. Draw your family and practise presenting each person in English — remember, family is love!

enonce.question: Choose: My father's mother is my ___. (grandmother / sister / baby)
Fill in: This is my ___. Her name is Amel. (mother / father / brother)
Choose: The boy in my family is my ___. (brother / sister / grandmother)
Choose: This is my father. ___ name is Tarek. (His / Her)
Fill in: I ___ one brother and two sisters. (have / am / is)
Put the words in order: my / This / grandmother / is
Choose the correct sentence: (a) This is my sister. His name is Lina. (b) This is my sister. Her name is Lina.
